description: Write publishing metadata from what is said: title options (titleCount, default 5), description, hashtags and YouTube chapters with timestamps, per platform (youtube default, shorts, tiktok, instagram). Pass transcriptionJobId or subtitles (1 credit per platform), or only media (adds 1 credit per minute to transcribe). Written in the video's language unless language is set; context adds creator notes. Waits ~40 s, else poll get_job. Result: platforms.<platform>.{titles, description, hashtags, chapters}.

context.description: Optional notes for the writer (audience, tone, channel, keywords), max 500 characters.

durationSeconds.description: Media length in seconds. Lets the price be computed without fetching media (quoteOnly, quote, plan).

fileId.description: Id of a file already uploaded with upload {action:'start'}, upload {action:'start_multipart'}, upload {action:'inline'} or import_url. Pass this or the media URL.

language.description: Output language. Default: the video's language.

maxCredits.description: Spending cap for this call in credits (1 credit = 1 cent). If the price is higher the call fails with 422 before charging.

mediaUrl.description: Public https link to the video or audio (direct file, chat attachment URL, Google Drive or Dropbox share link; YouTube is refused). Pass this or fileId.

platforms.description: Platforms to write for (youtube, shorts, tiktok, instagram), 1-4. Default youtube.

quoteOnly.description: Free: return the price without starting a job or charging. With media only (no transcript) pass durationSeconds.

titleCount.description: How many title options to return, 1-10. Default 5.

transcriptionJobId.description: Finished job with captions (transcribe, caption_video, remove_silences, translate).

name: generate_metadata

outputSchema.description: A job: poll get_job with id until status is succeeded or failed.

error.description: Failure reason when status is failed.

expiresAt.description: When the result files are deleted.

id.description: Job id: pass it to get_job, resume_job, edit_transcript or as transcriptionJobId.

kind.description: Job kind (transcribe, burn, caption, clips, shorts, trim, dub, translate, preview, metadata...).

result.description: Result when succeeded: url, files[{name, url}], clips, text...

title: Titles, description, hashtags and chapters
